## Summary

Fixed both audit-confirmed findings on PR #53 and pushed to the same branch (`worker/task-20260727-122935-projexa-e2e--pm-site-engineer-role-model`):

1. **Missing role gate**: `punch-list/[id]/route.ts`'s PATCH now calls `requireRole(ctx, ROLE_GROUPS.FIELD)`, identical to its sibling POST.
2. **No role-assignment mechanism**: added `PATCH /api/org-members/[id]` (gated to a new `ROLE_GROUPS.ORG_ADMIN = ["owner","admin"]`) plus a role-select control in the Settings page's Team table, giving owners/admins a self-serve way to promote `member`-role users — closing the lockout risk without loosening enforcement on the other 5 routes.

Added two new test files (8 tests total, all passing) proving both fixes; `tsc --noEmit` is clean and all 35 unit tests pass. Updated PR #53's description with an explicit "Audit-fix round" section addressing the regression concern, and updated the branch's own PROGRESS.md.

Confirmed via `git merge-tree` that the only conflict with current `main` is the cosmetic per-task `PROGRESS.md` scratch file — no real code conflicts.

Per the task's constraints, I did **not** merge this — it needs a fresh supervisor audit per AGENTS.md Rule 7c.
